# MaLiang

> Provider-neutral Python tools for deterministic game-art preparation, records, and review; not an image-generation service.

Distribution: `maliang-game-art`; import: `maliang_art`; CLI: `maliang-art`.
Current-source `design` and `flow` features are not in the v0.1.0 tag.
Links below are source-repository paths; use a checkout, not a wheel, for the skill
and runbook. This index does not imply automatic agent discovery or skill loading.

## Start here

- [Quick start (English)](README.md) / [简明入门（简体中文）](README.zh-CN.md): purpose, origins, Windows installation, Agent setup, and examples.
- [Getting started (English)](docs/getting-started.md) / [入门教程（简体中文）](docs/getting-started.zh-CN.md): offline demo output explained, first sample brief.
- [Concepts (English)](docs/concepts.md) / [核心概念（简体中文）](docs/concepts.zh-CN.md): glossary and lifecycle.
- [Agent setup (English)](docs/agent-setup.md) / [Agent 接入（简体中文）](docs/agent-setup.zh-CN.md): Agent/LLM configuration checklist.
- [Usage reference (English)](docs/usage.md) / [使用参考（简体中文）](docs/usage.zh-CN.md): versions, CLI, Python API, and behavior boundaries.
- [Usage skill](skills/maliang-art/SKILL.md): asset preparation and review, explicit project-root setup, and opt-in host installation.
- [Art-pilot (English)](examples/art-pilot/README.en.md) / [示例（简体中文）](examples/art-pilot/README.md): synthetic regression and distribution limits.
- [Runbook (English)](examples/art-pilot/docs/runbook.en.md) / [运行手册（简体中文）](examples/art-pilot/docs/runbook.md): the authoritative bilingual production workflow—prepare, external execution/import, exact-result checks, human review, and adoption.

## Interfaces and safety

- [Package CLI](src/maliang_art/cli.py): actual package commands; use `python -m maliang_art --help`.
- [Production sample](examples/art-pilot/scripts/production.py): repository script, not a package production subcommand.
- [Python API exports](src/maliang_art/__init__.py): public entry points.
- [Record schemas](schemas/v1): versioned JSON contracts.
- [Development guidance](AGENTS.md): changing MaLiang, not launching generation.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): developer setup and verification.
- [Security and limitations](SECURITY.md): trust boundaries; host tools and real human approval remain external.

## Optional design plans — nonfunctional references

- [Image execution providers](docs/compose/spec/image-execution-providers.md): planned bridge, not an implemented API or executable command; manual host trials do not deliver it.
- [Agent usage documentation](docs/compose/spec/agent-usage-documentation.md): design and delivery evidence, not a runtime entry point.
